text:
zoe-partners: Heads-up: vendor sent a revised ETA for H200 and Gaudi. Need quick alignment on SDK drop windows and fallback routing so SI integrators and marketplace listings stay stable.

adam-eng: Main blocker is Gaudi driver ABI change. We'll need 48-72h to rebuild cert images after latest SDK.

mica-product: Proposal: lock SDK download 72h before any Phase 1 soft-listing. Phase 0 integrator dry-run gets access earlier but marked as 'pre-release'.

lee-ops: Fallback routing proposal: prefer same-region, then same-continent, then cross-continent with latency tag. We'll expose this in marketplace metadata. Example: {sku:h200, prefer:eu-west, fallback:[eu-central,us-west], maxLatencyMs:120}.

infra.bot: Vendor note: H200 test images expected W+3, Gaudi debug drivers are W+2. Embargo rules apply.

zoe-partners: Actions:
- adam-eng: validate Gaudi ABI and post results (W+2)
- lee-ops: publish fallback JSON and marketplace gating fields (W+1)
- mica-product: draft gated copy and integrator access plan (W+1)

adam-eng: Will do. If vendor slips, default is move secondary regions to 'staggered' lane and delay press.

zoe-partners: Keeping thread as canonical lane/gating source. Ping me for escalations. :thumbsup:
